A slight yellowing of the eyes can be easily dismissed as a sign of exhaustion. Dark urine may be blamed on dehydration, whereas loss of appetite or indigestion may be put down to stress.

stories.summary: Sixty-three students and teachers sought treatment from hospital after showing symptoms of food poisoning after eating from a restaurant at Kattappana in Idukki on Sunday night. In a statement, Bisleri International said the samples in question were taken from one of its 143 plants in September 2025.

stories.title: Bembem, Bentla, Ancheri, Coutinho emerge winners in AIFF SOM polls
stories.summary: Former India players Bembem Devi, Bentla D'Coth, Jo Paul Ancheri and Bruno Coutinho were on Monday elected as four Sportspersons of Merit (SOMs) to become members of the General Body of the All India Football Federation (AIFF) for the December 20 polls. stories.title: Saliva should be used to shine ball again - Gill
stories.summary: India captain Shubman Gill says that players should be allowed to use saliva to shine the ball again, six years after it was outlawed. The ban was first introduced by the International Cricket Council (ICC) as a result of the Covid-19 pandemic, in May 2020, before being made permanent in 2022.

stories.title: Shubman Gill wants ICC to revisit Covid-era ban on saliva
stories.summary: Minutes after India’s tense Champions Trophy semifinal win over Australia in March 2025 in Dubai, pacer Mohammed Shami made an impassioned plea to the ICC. Twenty months later, the debate refuses to go away. India captain Shubman Gill called on the ICC to revisit the saliva ban, arguing that the Kookaburra ball was going soft far too quickly and making it increasingly difficult for bowlers on unresponsive surfaces.

stories.title: Rafael Nadal celebrates Real Madrid’s late winner with wife Mery Perelló and son in viral family moment
stories.summary: Rafael Nadal had plenty to celebrate at the Santiago Bernabéu on Saturday, November 21. The 22-time Grand Slam champion watched Real Madrid come from behind to beat Celta Vigo 2-1 and could not hide his excitement when Carlos Espí scored the winning goal. Sitting alongside his wife, Mery Perelló, and their eldest son, Nadal was caught on camera sharing a big family hug.

stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell is facing questions after a serious car accident in Tampa, Florida, left him hospitalized with major injuries.
